# Image Assets

Place all your images, screenshots, and other static files here.

### How to use images in your posts

To add an image to any of your markdown posts or essays, use standard markdown syntax with the `/assets/images/` path. 

For example, if you save a screenshot here named `my-screenshot.png`, you can include it in a post like this:

```markdown
![This is the alt-text description](/assets/images/my-screenshot.png)
```

Because we added responsive CSS rules earlier, your images will automatically scale perfectly to fit mobile screens!
